pages.text: Sifters are how you will obtain most of your bait, that is needed for fishing. Place the two blocks next to each other like a double chest. Right click items on to the sifter and then right click them again to sift. (Installing a Basic Storage Upgrade on a Sifter will give it an inventory)
pages.title: Sifter

pages.text: Fishing Nets when placed on water, overtime will randomly generate fish, as if they were being caught with a Reed Rod. You will need some way to collect the item entities that are produced.
pages.title: Fishing Net
